liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Dark Star** (3 reviews): The song begins somberly before evolving into an electrical thunderstorm; Listener calls the performance magical and well played, noting its luminescence [11][12][13]

## The recordings

- **gd70-09-19.aud-toner-weinberg.warner.25473.sbeok.flacf** (recommended): audience recording; 23 songs; 164 min; rated 2.75/5 by 4 [1]
- **gd70-09-19.sbd.kaplan.5217.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 10 songs; 70 min; rated 4.7/5 by 60 [3]. Said about its sound: Listener describes the recording as having good sound quality; Listener praises the superb sound quality and intimate, translucent nature of the performance; Listener notes a scraping, mechanical percussion instrument is more overpowering than usual [9][17][18]
- **gd1970-09-19.mtx.chappell.SB14.31510.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 10 songs; 68 min; rated 4.32/5 by 25 [4]. Said about its sound: Matrix combines excellent SBD with audience sources to add low end and crowd [4]
- **gd1970-09-19.150347.acoustic.aud.flac16**: audience recording; 12 songs; 49 min [2]

## Around the show

- Review suggests Jimi Hendrix's recent death influenced the band's bold emotional performance [11]
- Review identifies this as Pigpen's final performance of the song [15]
- Source 2 audience recording captures amazing crowd interaction with Pig Pen [4]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd70-09-19.aud-toner-weinberg.warner.25473.sbeok.flacf**: taped by Jack Toner and Marty Weinberg; transferred by Dwight Holmes, Dr. Michael Parrish, Steven Martin, Jack Warner; source: Composite Audience [1]. Also: Recording used a Sony TC-110 with a built-in microphone [1]
- **gd70-09-19.sbd.kaplan.5217.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Seth Kaplan; source: Soundboard [3]. Also: Transfer path includes MSR, DAT, CD, and Sonic Solutions processing; Seth Kaplan created the SHN file from the matrix [3]
- **gd1970-09-19.mtx.chappell.SB14.31510.sbeok.flac16**: taped by See info file; transferred by Matrixing by Chris Chappell; source: Sick Bits Vol. 14 Matrix By Chris Chappell [4]
- **gd1970-09-19.150347.acoustic.aud.flac16**: source: Source unknown, but thought to be Jack Toner's audience recording, part of which is available on the Warner 25473 composite copy. Lineage: AUD > ?? > CD WAV >… [2]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by Grateful Dead: [Grateful Dead Fillmore East - September 20, 1970](https://www.dead.net/show/september-20-1970) [22]
